name: Breadboard rails
description: The four distribution rails of an upright solderless breadboard: logic ground and logic power (+3V3 or +5V) on the left, motor ground and motor supply on the right.
notes: Used by layout: breadboard. The renderer draws these as the breadboard power strips instead of a device box. +3V3 and +5V share the left power strip (same column); use +5V for Arduino-class logic, +3V3 for Pi/ESP. The renderer ties GND to MGND whenever MGND is used. +24V is the external motor supply (EXT_POWER role).
